title: Satisfying physics animation
summary: Use code to make a satisfying animation of a ball breaking out of rings.
description: A ball bounces inside layer after layer of spinning rings, breaking through gaps to escape, with physics that feel real and keep the suspense going. Generated entirely in code, it makes a landscape short people want to watch again and again.
